text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected on production inference cluster (p99 latency > 2.5s) — streaming endpoints showing increased tail stalls. Paging oncall.

oncall-ryan: on it. seeing alert group for cluster-west-1-gpupool. any customer-facing incidents yet?

sre-alia: I'm seeing a spike in streaming stall errors and a correlated rise in `nvml: ECC correctable` logs on a subset of GPU nodes. p95 still OK, p99 is the problem.

infra-jun: which nodes? I can pull telemetry. `kubectl get pods -l accelerator=gpu -o wide` shows several pods on node gpu-12, gpu-13 with high GPU utilization + thermal events.

ml-eng-sara: Model-serving traces show KV cache misses and stalled token production for long sequences. When stall happens, pipeline backs up and latencies blow up. Possibly intermittent ECC correctable errors causing short stalls.

oncall-ryan: @infra-jun can you check SMART and dmesg on gpu-12/gpu-13? If GPUs are thermal/throttling we should evacuate.

infra-jun: grabbing logs. snippet from gpu-12 dmesg: ```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: GPU 0000:05:00.0: Xid (PCIe ID) 79: ECC error corrected.
[ 12345.679002] thermal: gpu thermal limit reached, clock throttled to 800 MHz
[ 12346.001234] nvhost: stall detected, scheduler preempted
```
Looks like correctable ECC + thermal probe spikes within same minute.

sre-alia: ok that's consistent with intermittent hardware flake causing micro-resets or stalls. mitigation plan: 1) route streaming traffic off affected nodes 2) enable fallback model-variant lower-memory/CPU path for in-flight requests 3) mark impacted customers and start CS comms.

oncall-ryan: I will start routing. `rictl node drain gpu-12 --grace=5m --reason="thermal/ecc stalls"` then same for gpu-13. Also `rictl route update --selector=!node=gpu-12,gpu-13` to avoid scheduling there.

deploy-bot: Deployment rollback monitor: no in-flight config changes detected. Canary ratio unaffected.

infra-jun: nodes are draining, pods rescheduled to gpu-21/gpu-23. I see throughput drop but latency improving at tail. p99 drops from ~3.1s -> ~1.4s after drain started.

pm-leo: @cs-ana please prepare hold message for impacted customers (streaming p99 elevated; mitigation in progress). Minimal data exposure risk, this is performance-only.

cs-ana: drafting now: "We're investigating increased response latency for streaming endpoints in US-West; mitigation underway and features remain available via fallback routing. We'll update in 30m."

ml-eng-sara: also toggling fallback model variant flag for streaming: `feature.flag.set("streaming_fallback_variant", true)` — this uses a narrower context-size exec path that avoids large KV hot spots. Should reduce stalls for long sequences.

sre-alia: good. also enable continuous batching reductions: reduce max-batch-size from 64 -> 32 for streaming to reduce queuing latency. Command: `rictl config set cluster-west-1 max_batch_size 32`

oncall-ryan: handoff note for next oncall: drained nodes gpu-12/gpu-13 due to ECC+thermal events; traffic routed to gpu-21/gpu-23; fallback variant enabled; CS notified. p99 back to target ~1.3s after mitigation. Leaving monitoring on for 2 hours. Paging @oncall-keen for 0200 UTC handoff.

infra-jun: I'm scheduling maintenance windows to replace GPUs on the two nodes; vendor ticket opened (TICKET-78291). We'll run extended burn test after swap.

cs-ana: sent initial customer note and added to incident page. No major customers reported failures yet, just increased latency alerts.

pm-leo: tagging severity: SEV3 -> SEV2 while p99 remained >2.5s earlier. Now scaling back to SEV3 if p99 stays <1.5s for 30m.

sre-alia: follow-ups: - GPU health telemetry: correlate ECC counts with thermal probes - Add alert rule to correlate `nvml_ecc_correctable`+`thermal_throttle` to reduce false positives - Run model-level evals to ensure fallback variant quality is acceptable.

oncall-ryan: thanks team. updating runbook and leaving the channel open. If tail spikes recur, escalate to hardware emergency protocols.

incidents-bot: Incident timeline recorded: start=2456789012, mitigated_by=drain+fallback+batch-reduce, severity=SEV2->SEV3, ticket=TICKET-78291.

oncall-keen: (acknowledged) I'll take the 0200 UTC handoff. Will monitor thermal/ECC counters and coordinate GPU swap with infra.
